current_boundary.gap: The required ZIP handoff is explicit, but extraction/materialization semantics are not normatively bound before the installer begins resolving the package root. The existing release_integrity module verifies the materialized tree and must remain the evidence authority for its file-set/hash scope.

pipeline.name: ARTIFACT_IDENTITY
pipeline.rule: Bind the received archive bytes to the expected release/build/pre-handoff identity before extraction. Unknown/mismatched artifact identity fails closed.

pipeline.name: FRESH_PRIVATE_STAGING
pipeline.rule: Create a new process/user-private empty staging directory for this extraction. Never extract over the repository, installed state, home directory, plugin cache or another pre-existing product tree.

pipeline.name: ARCHIVE_PREFLIGHT
pipeline.rule: Enumerate members before writing. Require canonical relative names; reject absolute/drive/UNC roots, dot/dotdot, NUL, ambiguous separators, exact duplicate names, unsupported special-file/link metadata and target-profile path collisions. Treat archive names as candidate paths, not authority.

pipeline.name: BOUNDED_EXTRACTION
pipeline.rule: Extract only into the fresh staging root using the admitted stdlib path. No code/import/hook execution occurs during or before extraction verification. For threat models with concurrent hostile filesystem mutation, use a stronger handle/dirfd no-follow/beneath primitive or fail closed; do not pretend lexical normalization is race-proof.

pipeline.name: POST_EXTRACTION_RELEASE_VERIFY
pipeline.rule: Run the existing release_integrity/load_and_verify_release_manifest plus portable static-completeness gates against the staged tree. Their no-symlink/non-regular and SHA-256/size/file-set checks remain authoritative at their declared scope.

pipeline.name: PROMOTE_STAGED_ROOT_FOR_INSTALLER_USE
pipeline.rule: Only a verified staged root may become package_root for route selection/install. Record extractor implementation/version, archive digest, staging identity and verifier result in the handoff/acceptance receipt.

why_not_new_framework: Current F2 baseline is CPython >=3.12 with a stdlib baseline.
The strongest existing F2 control is already a deterministic post-materialization manifest verifier; replacing it would duplicate authority.
Fresh private staging makes pre-existing destination symlink/junction attacks structurally harder and bounds any extraction overwrite to disposable data.
A mandatory Linux-only openat2 wrapper would reduce portability and is not justified unless the accepted threat model includes hostile concurrent mutation of the staging root.
cross_platform_notes: Archive member canonicalization must be stricter than trusting host extractor normalization because Windows drive/UNC/illegal-character normalization and case-insensitive filesystems can alias distinct archive names.

Post-extraction F2 verification should catch a materialized file-set/hash mismatch, but preflight collision rejection prevents ambiguous overwrite-before-fail behavior and makes the handoff deterministic.

WP1111 junction/symlink work remains responsible for link-like components in the already-materialized package. This candidate only ensures that the staged root reaches that verifier without becoming an implicit trust bypass.

counterhypotheses.statement: The receiving platform always provides a fresh isolated immutable extraction root and never executes package code before F2 verification.
counterhypotheses.impact: Then the candidate can collapse to a receipt/contract clarification plus archive member preflight; no new extraction module is needed.

counterhypotheses.statement: F2 never ships or consumes a ZIP byte artifact in the actual one-handoff implementation despite the architecture contract language.
counterhypotheses.impact: Then archive-specific implementation work is unnecessary and this E2 remains a contract-level gap only.

counterhypotheses.statement: Concurrent hostile mutation of the staging filesystem is within the product acceptance threat model.
counterhypotheses.impact: Fresh staging plus Python path operations are insufficient as a race-proof security primitive; a platform-specific handle-bound resolution design must be evaluated separately.

acceptance_falsifiers: A crafted archive with absolute, parent, duplicate, case-colliding or Windows-normalization-colliding names must be rejected before installer use.
A staged tree containing any symlink/junction/non-regular entry must not pass the existing post-extraction verifier at the target platform's declared link semantics.
Changing archive bytes while preserving a stale manifest/receipt identity must fail artifact binding.
No installer route, Python import, hook or executable payload may run before post-extraction verification is green.
The same exact archive and target profile must yield one deterministic admitted staged file set or fail closed.

resource_effect.cpu_io: one archive enumeration plus existing full file hashing; bounded by package size
resource_effect.preferred_implementation: reuse canonical path parser/manifest verifier and Python stdlib ZIP metadata; no framework import

next_exact_action: Claim and run one bounded E3 source-semantics reproduction: demonstrate whether CPython ZipFile extraction into a destination containing a pre-existing symlinked intermediate directory follows that destination link, and separately confirm that extraction into a fresh private staging root followed by F2 release_integrity rejects any resulting link/non-regular materialization. Use only a disposable local sandbox; do not claim target-host runtime credit.
